Deputy General Manager - GTL

Air Products Uzbekistan | 📍 Karshi, Uzbekistan

🏭 Join one of the largest industrial gas production facilities in the Europe and Africa region.

Air Products is seeking an experienced Deputy General Manager GTL to support the General Manager in leading safe, reliable, compliant, and profitable operations at our world-class GTL facility in Karshi, Uzbekistan.

The successful candidate will play a key leadership role across operations, technical services, maintenance, EHS, commercial activities, and customer relationships while driving operational excellence and business performance.

🏭 About the Facility
The Air Products GTL plant in Karshi features:
➤ Two Air Separation Units (ASU) with a capacity of 4,200 tons/day each
➤ Two Topsoe Auto Thermal Reformers (ATR)
➤ One Steam Methane Reformer (SMR)
➤ Approximately 170 employees across operations and support functions

✔️ Align Operations, Engineering, Maintenance, Commercial, and Support teams
✔️ Drive operational excellence, reliability, and performance improvement programmes

✔️ Strengthen governance, operational discipline, and process compliance
✔️ Manage stakeholder, customer, and partner relationships
✔️ Support talent development, succession planning, and organisational effectiveness
✔️ Represent the General Manager during periods of absence

🎓 Qualifications & Experience
✅ Bachelor's degree in Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial
✅ Engineering, or related discipline
✅ Minimum 15 years of leadership experience in industrial, petrochemical, refining, manufacturing, or energy facilities
✅ Proven experience leading complex operations and multidisciplinary teams
✅ Strong knowledge of asset reliability, maintenance, operational excellence, and safety management systems
✅ Experience with SMR and ASU technologies is essential
Strong commercial, financial, and stakeholder management skills
✅ Fluent English required
✅ Russian and/or Uzbek language skills preferred
✅ Willingness to relocate to Karshi, Uzbekistan

⭐ Preferred Qualifications
➕ MBA or Master's Degree
➕ PMP Certification
➕ Certified Reliability Leader (CRL), CMRP, or equivalent
➕ Lean Six Sigma Certification
➕ Process Safety Management Certification
➕ IOSH, NEBOSH, or equivalent HSE certifications

jobs.title: Internal Auditor - Business Operations
jobs.description:
At Air Products, we reimagine what’s possible. By tapping into the motivation of our people and our collective experience, we create the ideas and innovations that drive us forward. When we come together – where every voice is heard and everyone knows they belong and matter – we create solutions that launch people into space, support lifesaving care in hospitals, and enable the construction of groundbreaking, world scale production facilities.

Reimagine What’s Possible

Do you have a passion for uncovering insights, strengthening business processes, and driving continuous improvement? Air Products is seeking a highly motivated Internal Auditor to join our team in Allentown, PA . In this role, you will partner with stakeholders across the organization to evaluate financial controls, business processes, and operational effectiveness, helping to identify opportunities, manage risk, and support business success.

As an Internal Auditor, you will lead and execute a variety of audit engagements across Air Products' global operations, including finance, business processes, software systems, and regulatory compliance. You will be responsible for conducting thorough and well-organized audits, delivering clear and actionable recommendations, and communicating findings to key stakeholders. This position offers a unique opportunity to gain broad exposure to diverse business functions while contributing to the continued growth, efficiency, and integrity of the organization.

As a trusted partner to senior leaders across Industrial Gases, Product Delivery Organization, Digital Technology, Finance, Legal, and other business functions, you will provide assurance and recommendations on a myriad of business processes, relating to measurable business value. This position plays a critical role in providing assurance, identifying and mitigating risk, and supporting business objectives through strategic, best-in-class auditing practices.

Responsibilities:
- Develop audit engagement scopes of limited to moderate complexity, relying on knowledge of Air Products business developments/structure, challenges.
- Develop robust risk and control matrixes and audit testing procedures for audit engagements, relying on knowledge of Air Products core business risks (both inherit and emerging).
- Execute audit engagements of limited to moderate complexity, adhering to all internal and external audit work process standards.
- Interpret and organize information from audit engagements in a comprehensive, concise report, articulating observations, root causes, business risks, and relevant recommendations.
- Deliver report information in a professional manner to stakeholders.
- Identify control techniques from a process walkthrough (observation) and evaluate the control's ability to mitigate identified risks.
- Perform Sarbanes-Oxley testing of relevant controls using established templates but relying on analytical abilities and control understanding.

Qualifications:
- Associate’s degree in engineering, Supply Chain Management, Information Technology, Finance, or a related field.
- Minimum 2 years' experience in Engineering, Digital Technology, Sourcing, Procurement, or Operations.
- Professional certifications such as CPA, CIA are preferred but not required.
- Basic knowledge in Excel (formulas, pivot tables, graphs)
- Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders.
- Demonstrated ability to interpret policies, process documentation and procedures to determine compliance and identify areas of risk or noncompliance.
- Demonstrated basic data analytic techniques to extrapolate trends and observations from data.
- Demonstrated ability to learn and use relevant software required to complete an audit engagement or SOX testing’s.
- Understanding of simple project management concepts and techniques to deliver on objectives.
- Ability to perform multiple projects simultaneously, in various project/program stages.
- Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 10%.

What's In It for You:

At Air Products we foster a culture of inclusion where every voice is heard, and everyone feels they belong and matter. Additionally, we offer competitive pay and great benefits for our employees.

Check out some of our benefits below!

· Affordable medical, dental, and vision insurance available day one of employment
· 401(k) retirement savings plan with 100% vested company core and match
· Paid vacation, holidays, and sick time
· Paid parental leave
· Adoption assistance
· Flexible spending accounts
· Life Insurance (AD&D), Supplemental AD&D
· Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Purpose
It should be just one sentence that provides macro, concise view of the job. Below is a sample Purpose Statement for a Production Manager.

The Business Development Manager is responsible for leading and securing profitable onsite gas projects to support the sustainable growth of China IG, with a primary focus on Electronics Tonnage and bulk gas opportunities.

Nature and Scope

This is the narrative part of the JD. It is written in straight prose paragraphs, not in lists or headings. Being unstructured, it gives the writer to convey all the necessary facts together with something of the feel of the job. It provides the meat on the bones of the other parts of JD. It illuminates the job and helps the reader to have a good grasp on what the job entails without going into details. It should be easy to read, logical and interesting.

The job holder is the China Onsite Business Development manager for Electronics Tonnage in China reporting to China Onsite Senior Business Development Manager, China Onsite Business Development.

The jobholder is responsible for the sales / Business Development of the electronics tonnage business – bulk gases which is to align with China ETON Ambition strategy. To achieve this, this jobholder will be the local point of contact for the assigned ETON and bulk gas opportunities, interfacing with customers, marketing, engineering and other internal stakeholders, and external alliances as well as the local government officials accordingly.

During the bidding stage, the jobholder needs to comply with the company process to complete the following: project screening, bidding strategy development, project planning/definition, tendering/ bidding activities, contract negotiation, support project/contract execution. He/she needs to develop commercial strategies on new opportunities and enhance communications with internal stakeholders, customers and other external parties. And also, he/she will develop bid/proposal for new opportunities to achieve the targeted hit rate, sales and profitability goals.

After deal awarded, the jobholder is responsible for contract negotiation and supporting the business license set-up (if applicable). During the project execution stage, to support sub-regional business team in driving the project execution’s success.

The jobholder will partner with other business units such as liquid bulk/package gas to promote high purity package gas and its service and UHP LOX… etc by project base and act as the long-term business development manager for existing accounts to maintain and grow sales and profits, customer wallet share, new product introduction/service extension, etc.

The jobholder will lead or partner with sub-region team for franchise development includes liquid conversion, new business development etc which is part of the previous ETON projects’ franchise plan.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES
- Develop and execute business development plans aligned with China IG growth objectives.
- Define and lead commercial strategies for onsite project bids, ensuring competitiveness and profitability.
- Lead contract negotiations and secure agreements in compliance with company policies.
- Support business license setup where applicable and manage long term contracts to maximize sales and profit performance.
- Collaborate with liquid bulk and packaged gas teams to promote integrated product and service offerings.
- Partner with sub-regional teams to drive franchise development, including follow on and conversion opportunities from existing projects.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Qualifications and Requirements
- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering or business-related subject.
- Minimum of 3 years’ experience in gas business development, project management or engineering.
- Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to deal with people from all cultures at all organizational levels, inside and outside AP Excellent language skills.
- Able to communicate fluently in English/Chinese.

Required Skill Sets
- Leadership and Management Skills: ability to lead initiatives in business development and to manage a team to achieve business goals.
- Sales and negotiation Skills: ability to identify customer needs, develop proposals, and close sales for complex technical or long-term service contracts, interact effectively with customers to achieve win-win outcomes for the company and the customer.
- Technical Skills: ability to understand and work with the technical aspects of Onsite projects including a basic understanding of the product lines and our project execution methodology.
- Business Registration and Permitting Knowledge: ability to understand and work with Permitting team, GR and other related teams (tax team etc. to result permitting challenges and maximize benefits from a new business investment through teamwork.
- Financial Knowledge: Strong understanding of the onsite gas supply business model. Ability to work with financial analyses to evaluate project structure (including technical details) which impact financial returns.
- Legal Knowledge: Ability to conduct effective negotiations, and to put legal documents together. These include letters of intent, contracts and land leases.
- Leadership and collaboration: Ability to work with people from different backgrounds in terms of culture and discipline internally and externally; ability to lead a team of personnel in a matrix environment.
- Commercial and Business Acumen: a sound understanding of the competitive environment and competence in putting a deal together in the general direction of a remote supervisor.
- Problem-solving & independence: Self-motivated and resourceful, capable of working independently and resolving complex issues with minimal guidance. 10. Strong strategic thinking and analytical skills to overcome challenges and adapt strategies as needed.

📄 Typ pracovního poměru: Hlavní pracovní poměr na plný úvazek

👤 Vedení týmu: Bez přímé personální odpovědnosti

Připojte se k Air Products !

Hledáme Business Development Managera pro segment Merchant , který bude zodpovědný za správu a rozvoj svěřeného portfolia zákazníků v oblasti technických plynů v České republice. Na této pozici budete budovat dlouhodobé vztahy se zákazníky, identifikovat nové obchodní příležitosti, podporovat růst obratu a ziskovosti a pomáhat zákazníkům najít optimální produkty, dodavatelské modely a technická řešení.
Budete úzce spolupracovat s kolegy z obchodu, technické podpory, marketingu, zákaznického servisu, engineeringu i podpory distribuční sítě, abyste zákazníkům poskytovali bezpečná, spolehlivá a komerčně atraktivní řešení.
Jedná se o vysoce zákaznicky orientovanou pozici, kde jsou klíčem k úspěchu efektivní plánování, pravidelné návštěvy zákazníků a důsledná práce s příležitostmi. Budete pečovat jak o stávající zákazníky, tak rozvíjet nové obchodní příležitosti napříč portfoliem produktů zahrnujícím tlakové lahve, CryoEase, Liquid Bulk a další řešení z oblasti Merchant Gases.

Jako Business Development Manager budete...
- Spravovat a rozvíjet svěřené portfolio zákazníků v oblasti Merchant Gases se zaměřením na růst objemů, obratu, cenové úrovně a ziskovosti.
- Budovat dlouhodobé partnerské vztahy se zákazníky, identifikovat jejich potřeby a navrhovat vhodná dodavatelská nebo technická řešení.
- Aktivně vyhledávat, rozvíjet a získávat nové zákazníky s využitím schválených obchodních nástrojů, znalosti trhu a interní podpory.
- Spolupracovat s týmy podporujícími distribuční síť, včetně EAM/Agent, Gas Taxi Support a Gas Taxi Sales.
- Propagovat celé portfolio Merchant Gases se zaměřením na prioritní produkty, technologie a růstové obchodní příležitosti.
- Efektivně plánovat návštěvy zákazníků, připravovat se na obchodní jednání, stanovovat další kroky a pravidelně reportovat výsledky a zpětnou vazbu svému manažerovi.
- Spolupracovat s interními specialisty z oblasti aplikací, marketingu, engineeringu a zákaznického servisu na vytváření řešení orientovaných na potřeby zákazníků.
- Dodržovat interní procesy a pravidla týkající se administrativy, smluv, obchodních schvalování, bezpečnosti práce, ochrany zdraví a životního prostředí.

Jako Business Development Manager již máte...
- Zkušenosti v oblasti B2B prodeje, péče o zákazníky, business developmentu nebo jiné obchodní pozici s přímým kontaktem se zákazníky.
- Schopnost spravovat stávající zákaznické portfolio a současně identifikovat a rozvíjet nové obchodní příležitosti.
- Dobré obchodní porozumění cenotvorbě, ziskovosti, potřebám zákazníků a plánování prodeje.
- Výborné komunikační dovednosti a schopnost budovat dlouhodobé vztahy se zákazníky i interními stakeholdery.
- Dobré organizační schopnosti, systematický přístup k plánování a důslednou práci s obchodními příležitostmi.
- Odpovědný přístup k bezpečnosti práce a dodržování interních procesů.
- Platný řidičský průkaz skupiny B a ochotu pravidelně cestovat v rámci svěřeného regionu.
- Plynulou znalost českého jazyka a komunikativní znalost angličtiny.

➕ Výhodou
- Zkušenosti v oblasti technických plynů, chemického průmyslu, výroby, strojírenství, logistiky nebo podobného technického odvětví.
- Znalost produktů jako jsou tlakové lahve, CryoEase, Liquid Bulk nebo jiných řešení v oblasti Merchant Gases.
- Zkušenost s prací v CRM systémech, reportingových nástrojích nebo jiných obchodních aplikacích.
- Schopnost spolupracovat s technickými specialisty a týmy zákaznické podpory na tvorbě řešení s přidanou hodnotou.

💼 Co V ám nabízíme
- Obchodní pozici s přímým dopadem na růst a úspěch společnosti Air Products na českém trhu.
- Možnost pracovat s širokým portfoliem technických plynů a rozmanitou zákaznickou základnou.
- Spolupráci se zkušenými kolegy napříč obchodními, technickými, marketingovými, zákaznickými a provozními týmy.
- Služební automobil i pro soukromé účely, mobilní telefon, notebook a další vybavení potřebné pro výkon práce.
- Strukturovaný onboarding, podporu vzdělávání a příležitosti k profesnímu rozvoji.
- Mezinárodní pracovní prostředí a kulturu založenou na spolupráci, bezpečnosti a inovacích.

Prohlášení o transparentním odměňování

Rozhodnutí o výši odměny jsou založena na objektivních kritériích souvisejících s pracovním místem, jako jsou zkušenosti, vzdělání, dovednosti, lokalita, rozsah odpovědnosti a prokázané kompetence. Manager of Business Development
Industrial Gases & Strategic Growth

We are seeking an experienced Business Development Manager to direct our Industrial Gases investment and growth strategy in Hungary. What you'll do
As the Business Development Manager, you will handle the identification, development, and delivery of strategic investment projects related to the Industrial Gases business. You will partner with senior customers, government partners, and internal leadership teams to formulate Air Products' growth strategy and advance complex investment opportunities.

Your key responsibilities will include
✔️ Directing business growth and investment efforts throughout Hungary, from spotting opportunities to completion
✔️ Building and handling a pipeline of strategic growth opportunities, including greenfield developments, asset expansions, and partnership opportunities
✔️ Driving commercial negotiations, deal structuring, and investment proposals for capital projects

✔️ Leading and progressing Business Development and Contract Management teams

✅ Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering or a related technical field

✅ Experience working in industrial gases, energy, chemicals, manufacturing, infrastructure, or related sectors
✅ Strong understanding of project financing, investment cases, cash flow modelling, and commercial evaluation
✅ Experience leading large-scale capital investment projects from concept development through approval and contracting
✅ Validated ability to engage and influence senior executives, customers, investors, and government collaborators

✅ Outstanding communication, collaborator management and negotiation skills
✅ Proficiency in Hungarian and English

➕ Experience in mergers & acquisitions, joint ventures, or strategic partnerships
➕ Previous responsibility for industrial asset management and contract governance
➕ International business development experience

Purpose
The incumbent is responsible for the profitable growth of the Industrial Gas (PGG) businesses in the geographical area assigned to him/her. He/she will have to win new business. He/she will develop new business for the direct channel. He/She will increase revenue from the sale of gases from existing and new accounts from the assigned area. Manage existing accounts and maintain relationship with them.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES
- To be responsible for sales of PGG and to achieve target set in the geographical area assigned to him/her

- To win new businesses (including new products from existing customers) To prepare business proposal and make presentation to potential customers

- To identify new business opportunities from the industrial listing or any other source of information and to prospect competitors’ customers through “cold-calling”.

- Pro-active stewardship of customers through regular and planned phone calls with all key decision making contacts in order to retain existing customers and grow portfolio in the geographical area assigned to him/her.

- Supporting the implementation of the price increase programs. Defending the general price increase (GPI) at enquiring customers; initiating and negotiating price increase proposals at customers where necessary

- To work with credit team and check on the prospects financial background before signing the business. To ensure collection target is met.

- To follow-up on lost business and work our strategies to re-gain them.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS
- Diploma/Degree in any business discipline.

- To have 1-3 years of sales experiences for heavy machinery industry, construction, sheet metal, metal fabrication or other relevant industrial industry.

- A positive and can do attitude is a must

- Excellent communication and presentation skills

- Able to work independently and possess a good team working spirit

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office application

- Driving license with possession of car

- Good communication skill in English.
